units.source_text: 也不知什么时候，五十米开外的地方出现了三个男人。

en.t: At some point, three men appeared about fifty meters away.

units.source_text: 他们穿着相同的衣服，一直蹲在地上，像在等着老头似的。

en.t: They were dressed alike and kept squatting on the ground, as if they were waiting for the old man.

units.source_text: 其中一人，膝上绕着个东西，怎么看都像是个望远镜。

en.t: One of them had something resting across his knees, and from any angle it looked like a telescope.

units.source_text: 不一会，加上老头共四个人，讨论起什么事来。

en.t: Before long, there were four of them including the old man, and they began discussing something.

units.source_text: 他们轮番搓着脚底下的沙子，像在激烈地争论。

en.t: They took turns scraping the sand under their feet, as if they were arguing fiercely.
